summary_en: Iwabuchi executed a block purchase of 19,900 shares (1.94% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at 14,140 yen per share on November 17, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 281.386 million yen. This execution is part of a broader buyback authorization of up to 34,000 shares (3.26%) approved on May 15, 2026, of which 14,100 shares totaling 191.619 million yen had been acquired as of November 16.
summary_jp: 2026年11月17日にToSTNeT-3で19,900株（発行済株式総数に対する割合1.94％）を1株14,140円で買い付けた。買付金額は2億8,138万6,000円。5月15日に決議した取得枠（上限3万4,000株、5億1,000万円）の実行であり、当該実行前の進捗状況は1万4,100株、1億9,161万9,000円。
